title: Publication
description: One paper. One file per paper, named year-firstauthor-firstword.json, e.g. 2024-tirana-workflow.json.

_how_to_fill.description: Instructions for whoever fills in the file. Ignored by the website.

title.description: Exactly as published, including its original spelling.

short_title.description: Optional short label for the homepage graph, e.g. "Mneme". Defaults to the title before any colon.

authors.description: In publication order, full names. Names matching a lab member's file link to their page automatically.

venue.description: Full venue, e.g. "IEEE INFOCOM 2024" or "IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing 19(3)".

url.description: Publisher page, if there's no DOI.

arxiv_label.description: Optional label for the arXiv button, e.g. "Extended version". Defaults to "arXiv".

eprint.description: Other preprint link, e.g. an IACR ePrint URL.

pdf.description: Link to a freely available PDF.

note.description: Short note shown with the paper, e.g. "Best Paper Award" or "Extended version of the INFOCOM 2020 paper".

themes.description: Research themes on the homepage this paper belongs to.

selected.description: true for papers in the homepage's Selected publications.
